text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important goal is text understanding: machines try to find meaning in words and sentences. NLP also makes translation easier, so people can read texts in different languages. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, which shows whether a review or comment is positive, negative, or neutral. Companies use this to learn what customers think. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily communication with technology is becoming simpler and more helpful.
